method: Codex read each full Chinese source and all three translations, corrected findings, and compared semantic and technical boundaries.

checks.coverage_and_meaning: 核对七节全部步骤、目录说明、九组私有配置、full/core区别、首次真实验证码登录、停止和开发顺序。

checks.language_and_terminology: English distinguishes startup subset, generated project, real login and layout captures; resource budgets remain recommendations rather than measured limits.
checks.images_and_links: 单张英文auth-login原图与正式登记一致且遮罩CAPTCHA；全部教程入口为 .en.md，脱敏首次登录证明仅一次人工登录。
